statement: The largest reptile in the world is the crocodile.
note: Label looks wrong: the saltwater crocodile is the largest living reptile

statement: Human digestion begins in the mouth and ends in the small intestine.
note: The large intestine also plays a role (water absorption, bacterial fermentation)

statement: Evolution occurs through the process of artificial selection.
note: Artificial selection does cause evolution in domesticated species; incomplete rather than clearly false
